SILKITA SONAWANE REGULATORY & TRANSACTION REPORTING ANALYST | MiFID II | CLIENT REPORTING | CAPITAL MARKETS

Ghatkopar (E), Mumbai - 400075 | +91 9137760091 | silkitasonawane01@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/silkita-sonawane28

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Experienced in analyzing trade and reporting data, investigating discrepancies, managing client enquiries and escalations, supporting UAT and regulatory change initiatives, and coordinating with clients, brokers and internal stakeholders through resolution. Exposure to Fixed Income and Equities across capital-markets workflows.

CORE SKILLS Regulatory & Transaction Reporting: MiFID II Transaction Reporting, Regulatory Submissions, Transaction Data Validation, Reporting Exceptions, Reporting Controls, Root-Cause Analysis Client Management: Client Enquiries, Client Regulatory Queries, Client Escalations, Issue Resolution, Stakeholder Management, Client-specific Reporting Products: Fixed Income, Equities, Equity-related Products Testing & Change: UAT, Functional Validation, Defect Management, Regulatory Change, Process Improvement Tools: SQL, Power BI, Excel, Bloomberg, Thomson Reuters Eikon, Mainframe

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Regulatory Reporting Associate - MAS Onboarding | BNP Paribas (Destar Consultancy Pvt. Ltd.) | Mumbai • Supported MAS regulatory onboarding and classification activities, ensuring client information and documentation complied with

Nov 2025 – Present

applicable regulatory requirements.

Collected, reviewed and validated client/KYC documentation and regulatory data for completeness, accuracy and reporting readiness.

Coordinated with stakeholders to resolve documentation gaps, data discrepancies and onboarding queries within defined timelines; maintained trackers for timely completion.

Feb 2023 – Nov 2025

Financial Analyst | eClerx Services Ltd. | Mumbai • Managed MiFID II Transaction Reporting activities, including transaction-data validation, report preparation, pre-

submission checks and timely regulatory submission.

Investigated reporting discrepancies, exceptions and data-quality issues, performed root-cause analysis and coordinated corrective actions through closure.

Managed client regulatory queries, enquiries and escalations related to transaction reporting, trade data and reporting requirements, providing timely updates and resolution within defined SLAs.

Supported clients in understanding MiFID II reporting requirements, reporting discrepancies and issue-resolution procedures, coordinating with clients, brokers, Compliance and Operations teams.

Supported UAT for MiFID II Transaction Reporting changes, including test execution, transaction/reporting output validation, defect triage and resolution before production implementation.

Supported client-specific transaction reporting projects and regulatory change initiatives, including requirement understanding, validation, issue resolution and implementation support. Worked across Fixed Income and Equities, supporting transaction data validation, reporting accuracy, and regulatory reporting controls.

Performed transaction-data reconciliation and validation as part of reporting controls, identifying reporting gaps and inconsistencies and supporting remediation.

Maintained BAU reporting trackers and MIS covering reporting volumes, exceptions, client issues and resolution status for management review.

Used SQL to extract and analyze transaction/reporting data, reducing processing time by 40%; conducted process walkthroughs and knowledge-sharing sessions for stakeholders and new joiners.

EDUCATION Bachelor of Accounts, Finance and Insurance | Shri M.M.P. Shah College of Arts, Science and Commerce | 2022

ACHIEVEMENTS Value Award for quickly learning the process and contributing to client satisfaction.
